name: E.SUN Financial Holding Company, Ltd.
summary: E.SUN Financial Holding Company, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, offers various financial banking products and services in Taiwan. It operates through Corporate Banking Unit; Individual Banking Unit; Overseas Branches and Subsidiaries; and others segments. It provides deposits; bills/checks discounting; syndicated loans; domestic remittances; commercial acceptances; domestic letters of credit and guarantees; custodian services and warehousing; rental of safe deposit boxes; and credit card services.
